warrants.quote: warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 5,529,420 shares of common stock (“the Investor Warrants”), at an initial exercise price of $1.50 per share. The Investor Warrants are exercisable upon issuance and will expire on September 27, 2027.
The Placement Agent Warrants are similar to the Investor Warrants, except that the initial exercise price of the Placement Agent Warrants is $2.125 per share.
